rationale: Small MIT-licensed Flask app whose actual core is resource-keyed booking: RESOURCE_INFO names the bookable resources, /bookings rejects a claim only when the same resource overlaps an existing one, and the FullCalendar view renders those claims as the shared busy record. Six UTF-8 files cover license, setup, implementation, config and UI. Used as structural reference only.

scenario.name: Afternoon claim on the shared conference room
scenario.audience: A staff member who needs the department conference room
scenario.objective: Check the room's calendar for a free window, claim it, and see a clashing claim refused while a cancellation reopens the time.
workflow: Open the room's week view and read its existing reservation blocks as busy time
Submit a 14:00-16:00 claim for Thursday with a purpose note
Submit a second overlapping claim and receive a refusal naming the conflict
Cancel the original claim and confirm the slot shows free again
acceptance: The week view shows each accepted claim against the named room
An overlapping claim for the same room is refused and no block is added
Cancelling removes the block so the 14:00-16:00 window reads free
